title: Indian Spinach and Lentil Stew
subtitle: with curry leaves, coconut and goat's yoghurt
description: Green lentils are fried with curry leaves, dried chillies, mustard and cumin seeds, then simmered with water spinach, coconut and yoghurt. Serve with rice.

steps.text: Boil plenty of water in a pot and cook the lentils uncovered over medium heat for 30 minutes until tender. Drain.

Heat the coconut oil in a pan and fry the finely chopped onion over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until golden. Add the curry leaves and fry for 2 to 3 minutes until dark green. Add the dried chillies, mustard seeds and cumin seeds, stir and fry for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the spinach, curry powder, lentils and coconut and stir.
Pour in the stock, add half the yoghurt and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and cook uncovered for 5 minutes until the spinach wilts.
Transfer to plates, sprinkle with a little coconut and pour the remaining yoghurt over the top. Serve immediately with a plate of rice.
